12:53: Ur ţzekkiɣ iman iw. Tanefsit, s tideţ, tezzuɣuṛ ar tuccḍa, siwa ma Iḥun Mass iw. Mass iw, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu".
12:54: Inna ugellid: "awit eţ id ɣuṛi, d laɛtiq iw". Mi s immeslay, inna: "kečč, assa, nefka yak adabu, laman".
12:55: Inna: "wekkel iyi ɣef lemxazen n tmurt, nek d amḥareb amusnaw".
12:56: Akka ay Nesseqɛad Yusef di tmurt, ad izdeɣ anda i s ihwa. Neţḥunu ɣef win i ɣ ihwan, ur Nesṛuḥu arraz iɛaṛḍiyen.
12:57: S tideţ, arraz n laxeṛt yif it, i wid iumnen u llan ţḥezziben.
12:58: Usan watmaten n Yusef, kecmen ɣuṛes, iɛqel iten, nitni ur t ɛqilen.
12:59: Mi sen ifka ţţɛabgat nnsen, inna: "awit iyi d gmat wen s babat wen. Day ur twalam ara zadeɣ awen lkil, u, nek, ifeɣ akw wid isnebgaten?
12:60: Ma ur iyi t id tebbwim ara, ur awen neţktili ɣuṛi, ur iyi d teţsamim ".
12:61: Nnan: "a nḥawet baba s fellas; akka ara nexdem".
12:62: Inna i iqeddacen is: "rret selɛa nnsen deg icekkaṛen nnsen, amar a ţ ɛaqlen mara awḍen ar twacult nnsen, amar a d uɣalen".
12:63: Mi bbwḍen ar babat sen, nnan: "a babat nneɣ, igdel fellaɣ lkil, azen gmat nneɣ yidneɣ, iwakken a d nektil. Nekwni, war ccekk, a nḥareb fellas".
12:64: Inna: "day a kwen amneɣ fellas, akken i kwen umneɣ, zik, ɣef gma s? Ṛebbi Yif akw imḥaraben. Neţţa Iţhunu sennig akw iḥninen".
12:65: Mi ldin lqecc nnsen, ufan tuɣal iten id selɛa nnsen. Nnan: "a babat nneɣ, ur nebɣi tagi, selɛa nneɣ tuɣal aɣ d. A d nessikrer i twacult nneɣ, a nḥareb ɣef gmat nneɣ, a d nernu ţţɛabga n ulɣwem. Tagi d ţţɛabga tushilt".
12:66: Inna: "ur t sedduyeɣ yidwen, d awezɣi, siwa ma tcubkem iyi s Ṛebbi, ard a yi t id terrem, siwa ma zzin awen". Mi s ɛahden, inna: "Ṛebbi d Awkil ɣef wayen id nenna".
12:67: Inna: "a tarwa, ur keččmet si yiwet n tebburt, kecmet si tebbura imgarraden. Ula i wen xedmeɣ, biţţa, ar loiha n Ṛebbi. Aḥuddu siwa win n Ṛebbi. FellaS ţţekleɣ, fellaS ay ţţeklen wid iţţkalen".
12:68: Mi kecmen akken i sen iumeṛ babat sen, ula i sen ixdem, biţţa, ar loiha n Ṛebbi. D ayen ilezmen kan i iseyya Yaqub, deg iman is. Neţţa, s tideţ, isɛa tamusni i s Nesselmed, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
12:69: Mi kecmen ar Yusef, ibbwi gma s ɣuṛes, inna: "nekkini d gma k, ur ɣwebbel ɣef wayen xeddmen".
12:70: Mi sen ifka ţţɛabgat nnsen, irra taqbuct deg ucekkaṛ n gma s. Sinna, iberreḥ uberraḥ: "a yat terkaf, kunwi, war ccekk, d imakwaren"!
12:72: Nnan: "nesṛuḥ taqbuct ugellid. Win iţ id ibbwin, ad as nefk ţţɛabga n ulɣwem. Nek, ḍemneɣ t".
12:73: Nnan: "s Ṛebbi, nniɣ teẓṛam ur d nusa ara a nessefsed tamurt, ur nelli d imakwaren".
12:74: Nnan: "d acu ay d aqeṭṭi s, ma teskadbem"?
12:75: Nnan: " aqeṭṭi n win i ţ ibbwin di tcekkaṛt is, d yiman is. Akka ay neţkafi imednas".
12:76: Ibda la iţqellib icekkaṛen, uqbel win n gma s, sinna, issuffeɣ iţ id seg ucekkaṛ n gma s. Akka ay Nefka ticeṛkeţ i Yusef. Ur izmir ad iṭṭef gma s, s lqanun ugellid, siwa ma Irad Ṛebbi. Nessalay, tiseddaṛin, win i ɣihwan. Sennig bu tussna, illa Umusnaw.
12:77: Nnan: "ma iuker, niɣ iuker, zik, yiwen n watma s". Iffer iţ Yusef ɣuṛes, ur asen ţ id inna ara. Inna: "aql akwen deg yir ḥala. Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Iẓṛa ayen d teqqaṛem".
12:78: Nnan: "a yameqwṛan, baba s, s tideţ, wesser. Eṭṭef yiwen segneɣ deg umekkan is. Nwala k, ih, telliḍ si lɛuṣam".
12:79: Inna: "ur aɣ Iɛammed Ṛebbi a neṭṭef, siwa win uɣuṛ nufa taɣawsa nneɣ. Mulac, war ccekk, a nili d imednas".
12:80: Mi uysen segs, mcawaṛen, inna umeqwṛan segsen: "day ur teẓṛim ara, ar babat wen tcubkem t s Ṛebbi, u, zik, tḍeggɛam Yusef? Ihi, ur ţṛuḥuɣ si tmurt a, d awezɣi, alamma iserreḥ iyi baba, neɣ Ifra Ṛebbi felli. Neţţa, Yif akw imḥaddan.
12:81: Uɣalet ar babat wen, tinem as: a babat nneɣ, mmi k, s tideţ, iuker. Ncehhed kan ɣef wayen neẓṛa, ur nessaweḍ i tbaḍnit.
12:82: Steqsi tamdint ideg i nella, akked terkift ukud nedda. Ih, d tideţ, ay d nenna".
12:83: Inna: "xaṭi! Lameṛ seg iman nnwen. Ilha ṣṣbeṛ. Amar Ṛebbi a yi ten id Iawi akw. Neţţa, s tideţ, d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw".
12:84: Ijuneb iten, u inna: "a lḥif iw ɣef Yusef"! Allen is ijegger itent uɣilif, innuɣben.
12:85: Nnan: "s Ṛebbi, tezgiḍ tesmektayeḍ d Yusef, alamma tuɣaleḍ d amuḍin, neɣ seg wid immuten".
12:86: Inna: "la ţcetkiɣ kan i Ṛebbi, s uneẓmi w akked uɣwbel iw. Ssneɣ, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ayen ur tessinem.
12:87: A yarraw iw, ṛuḥet, steqsit ɣef Yusef akked gma s. Ur ţţayset di tecḍaṭ n Ṛebbi. Ih, i iţţaysen di tecḍaṭ n Ṛebbi, siwa agdud ijehliyen".
12:88: Mi bbwḍen ɣuṛes, nnan as: "a yameqwṛan, nekwni akked twacult nneɣ, neţwaɣ. Nusa d s selɛa ṛxisen, semd as lkil, seddeq aɣ. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţkafi wid iţseddiqen".
12:89: Inna: "teẓṛam i tgam i Yusef akked gma s, mi kunwi, d wid ur nessin"?
12:90: Nnan: "kečč, s tideţ, mačči d Yusef "? Inna: "nek d Yusef, atan gma. Niɣ Iɣat aɣ Ṛebbi. Ih, wid iţḥezziben, wid iṣebbṛen ... Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Isṛuḥu arraz iɛaṛḍiyen".
12:91: Nnan: "s Ṛebbi ar k Ismenyaf Ṛebbi garaneɣ. Nekwni, s tideţ, necceḍ".
12:92: Inna: "ur telli tiyta degwen, assa. Ad awen Isemmeḥ Ṛebbi! Neţţa Yif akw wid iţḥunun.
12:93: Awit tasedrit iw agi, erret eţ ɣef udem n baba, ad iḥlu yiẓṛi s. Aset ed ɣuṛi, s twacult nnwen, meṛṛa".
12:94: Mi teqlaɛ terkift, babat sen ibda la iqqaṛ: "nek, s tideţ, sraḥeɣ rriḥa n Yusef, awi d kan ur teqqaṛem ara: la isxeṛwiḍ".
12:95: Nnan: "s Ṛebbi, ar k mazal di ttelfan ik n zik".
12:96: Mi d iusa ubcir, issers as ţ ɣef udem is, llint ed wallen is, inna: "day ur awen nniɣ ara: nek ssneɣ, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
12:97: Nnan as: "a babat nneɣ, ssuter ad aɣ ţwasemmḥen ibekkaḍen nneɣ. S tideţ, nella d imednab".
12:98: Inna: "deqqal ad ssutreɣ, i Mass iw, ad awen Isemmeḥ. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu".
12:99: Mi bbwḍen ar Yusef, isteṛḥeb s imawlan is. Inna: "kecmet ar Maseṛ, di laman, ma Irad Ṛebbi".
12:100: Issuli imawlan is ar usgeld. ɣlin, knan as. Inna: "a baba! D wagi ay d asefru n targit iw, n zik. Niɣ Issuffeɣ iţ Mass iw! Niɣ Iga yi leqṛaṛ mi yi d Issuffeɣ si lḥebs. Ikkes ikwen id si sseḥṛa, deffir tismin i isker Cciṭan, gari d watma. Mass iw, s tideţ, d Laṭif i win i S ihwan. Ih, Neţţa d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
12:101: A Mass iw, niɣ Tefkiḍ iyi si tgelda, Tesḥefḍeḍ iyi asefru n temsal. Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Kečč, d Bab iw di ddunit, di laxeṛt, Eddem ṛṛuḥ iw d amḍua, Ssiweḍ iyi ar wid imaɛnen".
12:102: Tagi, si teḥkayin n tbaḍnit, Nweḥḥa yak ţ in. Ur telliḍ ɣuṛsen, mi mwafaqen a ţ andin.
12:103: Tegwti n yimdanen, xas tɛaţbeḍ, ur ţţamnen.
12:104: Ur asen ssutur kra n teqdiɛt. Neţţa, d asmekti kan i imaḍalen.
12:105: I illan deg issekniyen di tmurt akked igenwan! La teddun fellasen, maca wexxṛen asen.
12:106: Tegwti, segsen, ur ţţamnen s Ṛebbi, siwa ma curken.
12:107: Day ţţeklen ur asen isburru yara uɛaqeb n Ṛebbi, neɣ ur ten id iţţas ara yimir, deqzalla, ur ţfaqan?
12:108: Ini: "wagi d abrid iw, la ţnujuɣ ar Ṛebbi ad Ildi allen, i nek akked wid iddan yidi. Gedha s Ṛebbi! Ur lliɣ seg wid iţcaraken".
12:109: Nuzen ed kan, uqbel ik, irgazen seg imezdaɣ n temdinin, iwumi Nweḥḥa. Day ur unagen ara di tmurt, ad walin amek teḍṛa d wid i ten id izwaren? Ih, ţifxiṛ axxam aneggaru i wid iţḥezziben. Day ur tefhimem ara?
12:110: Alamma, mi uysen imazanen, u meyyzen ar skaddben ten, tusa ten id tallalt sɣuṛneɣ. Neţsellik win i ɣ ihwan. Ur iţwakkas ara ssxeḍ nneɣ, i ugdud ibeɣwḍiyen.
12:111: Niɣ, di teḥkayin nnsen, illa uselmed i yuɛqilen. Ur telli d awal id innulfan. Neţţat tetebbet ed ay d izwaren, tfeṣṣel ed yal cci. D nnhaya u d aḥunu i ugdud iumnen.
13:1: Almṛ. Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt. Ayen i k d irsen, sɣuṛ Mass ik, d tideţ, maca tegwti n medden ur ţţamnen.
13:2: Ṛebbi i Issulin igenwan war tigwejda ara twalim, sinna, Iɛannec ɣef usgeld. Iḥeţţem i yiṭij d waggur ad ddun, akw, ar lajel iţwassnen. Iseyyi lameṛ, Iţfeṣṣil issekniyen, amar a ţeţţutebbtem ɣef temlilit d Mass nnwen.
13:3: Neţţa i Isswesɛen tamurt. Irra degs idurar, isaffen. Irra tayuga di yal ţţemṛa. Iţɣummu ass s yiḍ. Deg waya, s tideţ, d issekniyen i ugdud iţxemmimen.
13:4: Di tmurt, tibḥirin tioiratin, leonanat n tẓuṛin, nnaɛma, tizdayin, ḍɣan neɣ ur ḍɣin, cerken aman nnsen. Nesmenyaf kra i kra, i wučči. Deg waya, s tideţ, d issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.
13:5: Ma twehmeḍ, issewham ay d qqaṛen: "ma nuɣal d akal, day fellaɣ, s tideţ, lxelq amaynut"? D wigi i inekṛen Mass nnsen. Wigi, azaglu ɣef tmegṛaḍ. Wigi d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkṛen.
13:6: Sḥaren k ar tucmiţ, uqbel iseɣ. Niɣ ḍṛant am tigi, uqbel nnsen. Mass ik, s tideţ, ɣuṛeS ssmaḥ i imdanen deg wayen ccḍen. Mass ik, s tideţ, Iwɛaṛ deg uɛaqeb.
13:7: La qqaṛen wid ijehlen: "a lemmer id irs ɣuṛes ussekni, sɣuṛ Mass is". Kečč, d aneddaṛ kan. I yal agdud, win inehhun.
13:8: Ṛebbi Iẓṛa i illan di yal tadist, amek teddun inzikmiren. Yal cci, ɣuṛeS, s lmizan.
13:9: Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir. Ameqwṛan, Aɛlayan.
13:10: Iɛuḍa segwen win iɣemḍen awal, d win it iberḥen, win iffren deg iḍ, d win d iḍehṛen deg wass.
13:11: Isɛa iɛssasen zdat es, deffir es, ţḥaraben fellas, s lameṛ n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iţbeddil i illan deg ugdud, alamma bedlen i illan deg iman nnsen. Ma Irad Ṛebbi ayen n dir, i ugdud, ur t itekkes yiwen. Ur sɛin amɛiwen, war Neţţa.
13:12: D Neţţa i wen d Iţţawin lebṛaq, degs tugdi, asirem. Isskar ed asigna aẓayan.
13:13: Tesbuccuɛ aS termegt, s ccekṛan, akken lmalayek, seg wakken ugadent eP. Iţţazen ed ssiɛqat, Iţḥaz yisent win i S ihwan. Nitni ţnamaren ɣef Ṛebbi. Neţţa teqseḥ tezmert iS.
13:14: ɣuṛ Neţţa, anuju n tideţ. Wid uɣuṛ la ţnujun, war Neţţa, ur asen d ţţaran s wacemma. Am win issendin ifassen i waman, ibɣa ad awḍen s imi s, ur ibbwiḍ ar lebɣi s. Anuju ijehliyen ar ttelfan kan.
13:15: I Ṛebbi la kennun wid illan di tmurt akked igenwan, bɣan neɣ ugin, akked tili nnsen, taṣebḥit, tameddit.
13:16: Ini: "anwa ay d Mass n tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Ṛebbi. Ihi day a ţţerrem d iḥbiben, war Neţţa, wid ur nemlik, i yiman nnsen, abaɣuṛ neɣ ḍḍeṛṛ"? Ini: "day iaɛdel uderɣal akked win iţwalin? Neɣ, day ɛadlent tillas akked tafat? Neɣ, rran imcurak i Ṛebbi, i ixelqen am lxelq iS, ufan t iţţemcabi"? Ini: "d Ṛebbi i Ixelqen yal cci. D Neţţa ay d Yiwen, d Aqehhaṛ".
13:17: Isseɣlay ed aman, seg igenni. Serrun deg ɣezṛan, s leqdeṛ nnsen. Acercuṛ iţţawi ikuftan iţţifliwen. Pţemcabin ikuftan ar wayen fessin di tmes, iwakken ad ṣenɛen ṛṛḥuḥ neɣ dduzan. Akka ay d Isskan Ṛebbi tideţ akked tkerkas. Ihi ikuftan ad ţţuḍeggṛen, ma d wayen inefɛen medden, a d igwri di tmurt. Akka ay d Iţţak Ṛebbi imedyaten.
13:18: Lfayeq i wid ijawben i Mass nnsen. Wid ur aS njaweb ara, xas ad sɛun i illan akw di tmurt, berdayen, ur ten id ifeddu. I widak, leḥsab adiran. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A tanezduɣt tucmiţ!
13:19: Day win iẓṛan ar ayen i k d irsen, sɣuṛ Mass ik, d tideţ, am win idreɣlen? Siwa uɛqilen id ismektayen.
13:20: Wid iṭṭfen di laɛqed n Ṛebbi, ur ţṛuẓun nnesba.
13:21: Wid issemlilen ayen id Iumeṛ Ṛebbi ad imlil, u ţţagwaden Mass nnsen, u ţţagwaden aqeṭṭi adiran.
13:22: Wid iṣebṛen, ssaramen udem n Mass nnsen, bedden i tẓallit, ţseddiqen seg wayen is iten Nɣat, s tuffra u ɛinɛni, swexxiṛen tucmiţ s yiseɣ. I nitni, agwaḍ s Axxam.
13:23: Leonanat n Ɛaden ara kecmen, akked wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, seg ibabaten nnsen, si tlawin nnsen, si tarwa nnsen. Lmalayek a d ţţasent ɣuṛsen si yal tabburt.
13:24: Tifrat fellawen, ilmend n wayen tṣebṛem! D asaɛdi, wagwaḍ s Axxam!
13:25: Wid iţṛuẓun laɛqed n Ṛebbi, deffir lemwafaqa s, wid igezmen ayen d Iumeṛ Ṛebbi ad imlil, u ssefsaden di tmurt, wigi, i nitni xezzu, i nitni yir axxam.
13:26: Ṛebbi Issugut ṛṛeẓq i win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Taɛoeb iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Tameddurt n ddunit, d urar kan, zdat laxeṛt.
13:27: La qqaṛen wid ijehlen: "a lemmer id iris, ɣuṛes, ussekni sɣuṛ Mass is"! Ini: "Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Itellif win i S ihwan. Inehhu ɣuṛeS, wid isteṛoiɛen,
13:28: wid iumnen, iwumi itheddin wul, mara d mmektin Ṛebbi". Niɣ, s usmekti n Ṛebbi, ţheddinen wulawen.
13:29: Ssaɛd, akked taggara igerzen, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan.
13:30: Akka ay k id Nuzen, i lois id zwaren leoyus, ad asen temleḍ, ayen ik d Nweḥḥa. Nitni jehlen ɣuṛ Uḥnin. Ini: "Neţţa d Mass iw, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa; ţţekleɣ fellaS, asteṛoaɛ iw ɣuṛeS".
13:31: A lemmer kan Leqwṛan isselḥa idurar, iceqqeq tamurt, neɣ issenṭeq ed lmeggtin! Xaṭi! Lumuṛ akw i Ṛebbi. Day ur ẓṛin ara wid iumnen, ar, ma ihwa yaS, Ṛebbi ad Inhu medden meṛṛa? Zgan wid ijehlen a ten tewwet ssixṭa, ilmend n wayen xeddmen. Neɣ a ţţeḍṛu ar tama n yixxamen nnsen, alamma tusa d lemɛahda n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iţzeggil ţţaɛud.
13:32: Niɣ mmaɛlken, uqbel ik, deg imazanen. Ooiɣ lmudda i wid ijehlen, sinna, Ṭṭfeɣ ten. A yaɛaqeb iW imiren!
13:33: Day Win Ibedden, ar yal amdan, ɣef wayen ikseb…? Curken aS i Ṛebbi. Ini: "semmit asen! Neɣ, ad aS temlem ayen ur Iẓṛi di tmurt? Neɣ d ismawen n tkerkas"? Xaṭi! Wid ijehlen, ɛaobent ţen nncub nnsen. Pţuḍeṛṛfen seg ubrid. Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur isɛi w ara t inhun.
13:34: Fellasen aɛaqeb, di tmeddurt n ddunit. Aɛaqeb n laxert, s tideţ, aɛer. Ur sɛin ara ten ifukken, seg ufus n Ṛebbi.
13:35: Amek tga Loennet i iţţuweɛɛden i wid iḥezzben: ddaw as isaffen ţţazzalen, lqut is akked tili s, d imezgiyen. D tagi ay d taggara n wid iḥezzben. Taggara ijehliyen, d times.
13:36: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, ad feṛḥen s wayen i k d irsen. Illa wayen ugin kra ikabaren. Ini: "ţwamṛeɣ kan ad ɛabdeɣ Ṛebbi, ur aS ţcarakeɣ. Pnujuɣ ɣuṛeS, tuɣalin iw ɣuṛeS".
13:37: Akka ay t id Nessers, d ṣṣwab, s taɛṛabt. Ma teddiḍ d lhawiyya nnsen, deffir tisin n tussna ɣuṛek, ur k iţfukku bab neɣ asettaṛ, seg ufus n Ṛebbi.
13:38: Niɣ Nuzen ed imazanen, uqbel ik, Nefka yasen tilawin, tarwa. Ur iţţunefk ara i umazan a d iawi assekni siwa ma Iɛammed Ṛebbi. Yal lajel s Tezmamt is.
13:39: Iseffeḍ u Itebbit Ṛebbi ay S ihwan. ɣuṛeS tayimmaţ n Tezmamt.
13:40: Ama Nessken ak kra n wayen i sen Nɛahed, ama Neddem ṛṛuḥ ik, ay fellak kan d isallen, ay fellaɣ d aqeṭṭi.
13:41: Day ur walan ara Neţţas ed ar tmurt, Nessenqas di leryaf is? Ṛebbi Iţseyyi; yiwen ur iţnamar aseyyi iS. Neţţa, Iţɣawal di leḥsab.
13:42: Niɣ ţţandin wid i ten id izwaren. Tiḥeṛci, akw, ar Ṛebbi. Iẓṛa i ikseb yal iman. Ad ẓṛen ijehliyen anwa ara iawḍen s Axxam.
13:43: Qqaṛen wid ijehlen: "ur telliḍ d amazan". Ini: "ad Iqadd Ṛebbi d Anagi gari yidwen, akked kra isɛan tussna n Tazmamt".
14:1: Alṛ. Tazmamt, Nessers ak ţ id, iwakken a ţţessuffɣeḍ imdanen si tillas ar tafat, s wannuf n Mass nnsen, s abrid n Wuzmir, Amaɛzuz,
14:2: Ṛebbi ilan i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. A ssxeḍ ijehliyen, ilmend uɛaqeb uqsiḥ,
14:3: i ismenyafen tameddurt n ddunit wala laxeṛt, i iswexxiṛen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi, u ssaramen t d uɛwij! Widak, atnan di ttelfan uɣmiq.
14:4: Ur d Nuzen amazan, siwa s tmeslayt n ugdud is, iwakken ad asen ibeggen. Ṛebbi Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. Neţţa d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
14:5: Ih, niɣ Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nneɣ: "ssuffeɣ agdud ik, si tillas ar tafat. Mmekti yas d ussan n Ṛebbi". Deg waya, war ccekk, d issekniyen i yal aṣebṛi isnemmiren.
14:6: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "mmektit ed lɣit ikwen Iɣat Ṛebbi, mi kwen Isellek si lois n Ferɛun, i issuken fellawen lhemm uqsiḥ. Zellun arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Deg waya, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, d cedda tameqwṛaḥant".
14:7: Mi d Inna Mass nnwen: "ma tesnemmrem, ih, ad awen Rnuɣ. Ma tjehlem, aɛaqeb iW, war ccekk, ad iwɛaṛ".
14:8: Inna Musa: "ma tjehlem, kunwi akked wid n tmurt meṛṛa, ihi, Ṛebbi d Asɛay, d Amaɛzuz".
14:9: Day ur kwen id ibbwiḍ ara usali imezwura nnwen: agdud n Nuḥ, Ɛad, Tamud, akked wid iten iḍefṛen? Ur ten issin yiwen, siwa Ṛebbi. Usan ten id imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen. Rran ifassen nnsen s imawen nnsen, nnan: "S tideţ, nejhel ayen iɣef d teţţuceggɛam. Ih, nekwni di ccekk imcebbwel, ɣef wayen uɣuṛ la ɣ tneccdem".
14:10: Nnan imazanen nnsen: "day illa ccekk di Ṛebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan? Inecced ikwen id, iwakken ad awen Isemmeḥ kra ibekkaḍen nnwen, a kwen Ioo ar lajel iţwassnen". Nnan: "kunwi, s tideţ, d imdanen kan, am nekwni. Tebɣam ad aɣ tesṭixxṛem, seg wayen llan ɛabden imezwura nneɣ. Awit aɣ d adabu n ṣṣeḥ".
14:11: Nnan asen imazanen nnsen: "nekwni d imdanen kan, am kunwi, maca Ṛebbi Iteg ccan i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Ur aɣ iţţunefk ara ad awen d nawi adabu, siwa s wannuf n Ṛebbi. ɣef Ṛebbi ara ţţeklen lmumnin.
14:12: Acu i ɣ iuɣen, ur neţkal ara ɣef Ṛebbi? Niɣ Imla yaɣ iberdan nneɣ; neṣbeṛ, war ccekk, i lmerta i tesɛaddam fellaɣ. ɣef Ṛebbi ara ţţeklen, at letkal".
14:13: Nnan wid ijehlen i imazanen nnsen: "war ccekk, a kwen nessuffeɣ si tmurt nneɣ, neɣ a d tuɣalem ar ddin nneɣ". Iweḥḥa yasen d Mass nnsen: "s tideţ, a Nesqucc imednas,
14:14: dɣa, war ccekk, a kwen Nerr d imezdaɣ n tmurt, deffir sen". Ayagi, i win iţţagwaden tilin iW, iţţagwaden aberri W.
14:16: Loahennama deffir es, ad ites aman iwexmiyen.
14:17: Tissit d tijeɣwimin, ur izmir ad isseblaɛ. Tameţţant a d teţţas si yal tamnaṭ, neţţa ur iţmeţţat. Deffir es aɛaqeb uqsiḥ.
14:18: Amedya n wid ijehlen, ar Mass nnsen: igiten nnsen am iɣiɣden iɣef iẓdem waḍu, ass n tbuciḍant. Ur d ţţawin acemma, seg wayen kesben. D wagi ay d ttelfan uɣmiq.
14:19: Day ur twalaḍ ara, Ṛebbi Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tideţ? Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes, a d Iawi lxelq amaynut.
14:20: Ayagi, i Ṛebbi, ur illi d ayen izzenzafen.
14:21: A d rsen akw zdat Ṛebbi. Ad inin uṛhifen i imzuxiyen: "s tideţ, nella nedda yidwen, ma tzemrem ad aɣ tsellkem kra, seg uɛaqeb n Ṛebbi"? A d inin: "lemmer i ɣ Inha Ṛebbi, yili nwelleh ikwen. Iɛuḍa fellaɣ, neḥmeq neɣ neṣbeṛ, ur aɣ illi ssṛan".
14:22: Mi isuyya lameṛ, a d yini Cciṭan: "Ṛebbi, d ṣṣeḥ, Iweɛɛd awen lemɛahda n tideţ. Weɛɛdeɣ awen, ɣuṛeɣ kwen. Ur sɛiɣ adabu fellawen, siwa anecced nnwen. Tuɣem awal iw. Ur iyi ţlummut, lummet iman nnwen. Ur zmireɣ a kwen ɛawneɣ, ur tezmirem ad iyi tɛawnem. Nekṛeɣ wid iyi teţcarakem, zik. I imednas, s tideţ, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan".
14:23: Ad skecmen wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, ad wekkṛen dinna, s wannuf n Mass nnsen. Azul nnsen dinna d: "tifrat"!
14:24: Day ur twalaḍ ara, amek id Ifka Ṛebbi amedya? Awal lɛali am ttejṛa lɛali, iẓuṛan is ṛṣan, iferkawen is di tegnewt.
14:25: Teţţak ed lfakia s, di yal imir, s wannuf n Mass is. Iţţawi d Ṛebbi imedyaten i imdanen, amar a d mmektin.
14:26: Amedya n wawal ucmit, am ttejṛa tucmiţ, teqlaɛ sennig wakal, war leqṛaṛ.
14:27: Ṛebbi Itebbit wid iumnen s wawal utebbet, di tmeddurt n ddunit akked laxeṛt. Ṛebbi Itellif imednas. Ṛebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
14:28: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid ineṣfen lɣit n Ṛebbi, s tijehli? Ssersen agdud nnsen deg uxxam n twaɣit.
14:29: Loahennama ad ṛɣen degs: a yir leqṛaṛ!
14:30: Gan aS i Ṛebbi tanudda, iwakken ad telfen seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhut! S tideţ, leqṛaṛ nnwen d times".
14:31: Ini i imdanen iW iumnen, ad bedden i tẓallit, ad seddqen seg wayen iten Nɣat, s tuffra u ɛinani, uqbel a d ias wass ideg ur illi ssuq, ur telli tdukli.
14:32: Ṛebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, id Isseɣlayen aman seg igenni, Issufuɣ ed yissen ţţemṛa, d ṛṛeẓq i kunwi. Inub fellawen s isaffen, u s lbabuṛ i iteddun di yill, s lameṛ iS.
14:33: Inub fellawen s yiṭij d waggur, d imezgiyen. Inub fellawen s yiḍ akked wass.
14:34: Ifka yawen seg wayen akw i S tessutrem. Ma ţḥesbem lɣit n Mass nnwen, ur tessawaḍem. Ih, amdan, s tideţ, d amednus, d ajehli.
14:35: Mi inna Ibṛahim: "a Mass iw! Err tamdint agi d tin n laman, Ɛatq aɣ, nek d warraw iw, seg wannuz n tɛancuṛin.
14:36: A Mass iw, nitenti, s tideţ, telfent aṭas n medden. Win iddan yidi, neţţa, s tideţ, sgi. Win iyi ɛuṣan, Kečč, s tideţ, Teţsemmiḥeḍ, Teţḥunuḍ.
14:37: A Mass nneɣ! Nek rriɣ tanezduɣt, i kra n warraw iw, di teɣzut ibuṛen, ar Uxxam iK iṛqan. A Mass nneɣ! Iwakken ad bedden i tẓallit. Err ulawen n kra n medden, ad iḥninen ɣuṛsen, ɣit iten s ţţemṛat, amar ad snemmren.
14:38: A Mass nneɣ! Kečč, s tideţ, Teẓṛiḍ ayen neffer akked wayen nenna. Ur iffir wacemma i Ṛebbi, di tmurt neɣ deg igenni.
14:39: Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi iyi d Ifkan, di tewser iw, Ismaɛil akked Isḥaq. Mass iw, s tideţ, Issemḥas i tnaɛṛit.
14:40: A Mass iw, Err iyi ad beddeɣ i tẓallit. Akked kra, si tarwa w. A Mass iw, Steṛḥeb s unuju w.
14:41: A Mass nneɣ! Semmeḥ aneɣ, nek d lwaldin iw, akked lmumnin, ass ideg ara d ias uqeṭṭi".
14:42: Ur ţɣili ar Iɣfel Ṛebbi, ɣef wayen xeddmen imednas. Iooa ten kan, ar ass ideg ara beḥḥren allen.
14:43: Ad ţɣawalen, iqweṛṛa ffɣen d, allen ur ferzent, ulawen d ilmawen.
14:44: Nabi imdanen af wass ideg ara ten id yas uɛaqeb. Ad inin wid idensen: "a Mass nneɣ! Efk aneɣ lmudda wezzilen, a d njaweb i unabi K, a neddu d imazanen". "Day ur teggulem ara kunwi, zik, ar ur teţɣabem?
14:45: Tzedɣem ixxamen n wid iḍuṛṛen iman nnsen. U Nbeggen awen d amek i sen Nga, u Nefka yawen d imedyaten".
14:46: Niɣ undin ccbukat nnsen. Ccbukat nnsen haatent ar Ṛebbi, xas ma ccbukat nnsen d tid ara isseɣlin idurar.
14:47: ɣuṛek a ţɣileḍ Ṛebbi ad Izgel lemɛahda S, i imazanen. S tideţ, Ṛebbi d Uzmir, Iţţara d ţţaṛ.
14:48: Ass ideg tamurt a ţţuɣal mačči d tamurt; akken igenwan; a d asen ar Ṛebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaṛ.
14:49: A ţwaliḍ, assen, ibeɣwḍiyen ţwaqqnen wa ɣer wa.
14:50: Lebsa nnsen d qeḍṛan, times tɣumm udmawen nnsen.
14:51: Iwakken ad Ikafi Ṛebbi yal amdan, ɣef wayen ikseb. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţɣawal di leḥsab.
14:52: Wagi d anecced i imdanen, ad ţwanedṛen yis, ad ẓṛen ar siwa Neţţa ay d Ṛebbi Yiwen, a d mmektin uɛqilen.
